title: Technical handshake + evaluation roadmap for Atlas Retail integration
text:
Technical handshake + evaluation roadmap for Atlas Retail integration

["From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@atlasretail.com>, Priya Menon <priya.m@atlasretail.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro: technical handshake & evaluation roadmap for Atlas Retail

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier this week. I wanted to introduce the Redwood technical team and propose a short mutual action plan (MAP) to scope the evaluation and keep timelines tight. Below are suggested roles and an initial sequence to get to a close decision within three weeks.

Internal Redwood owners (cc'd):
- Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer) — technical lead for evaluation, demo, and smoke tests
- Neha Kapoor (ML Engineer) — evaluation scoring, prompt set, and quality gate owner
- Vivek Kulkarni (Account Exec) — commercial / timeline owner

Proposed initial MAP (attached as Atlas_MAP_v1.xlsx):
1) Kickoff (45m) — technical handshake, data flows, success criteria
2) Ingest + smoke test (48–72h) — sample dataset ingest and simple generation checks
3) Latency & cost profiling — run representative queries & throughput tests
4) Quality evaluation — run curated prompt set (see sample_prompts.txt) and review metrics
5) Decision & next steps — go/no-go + SOW/terms

Target close timeline: ~3 weeks from kickoff.

Can you confirm availability for a 45-minute technical sync on Monday, 30 Nov at 10:00 AM PT? If that doesn't work, please propose two slots and we will prioritize.

Attachments: Atlas_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78KB), sample_prompts.txt (text, 4KB)

Thanks — looking forward to pairing up.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
", 'From: Samir Shah <samir@atlasretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@atlasretail.com>, dev_patel@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro: technical handshake & evaluation roadmap for Atlas Retail

Thanks Hannah — this looks good and appreciate the clarity. 11/30 at 10:00 AM PT works for our team (that’s 1:00 PM ET).

A couple of asks before the call so we can prepare the right folks on our side (security and platform leads):
- Can you share a completed version of your standard security questionnaire and the primary contact for SOC2 / infra questions?
- We’ll want a short ingestion example (sample schema + recommended batch size) so our data engineering team can review ahead of time.

I’m looping in Priya (our engineering lead) and she may add a couple more folks to the calendar invite.

Best,
Samir Shah
Head of Platform Integrations
Atlas Retail
samir@atlasretail.com
+1 (212) 555-0910

Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks for confirming the time. Quick technical note and proposed hands-on plan so teams are aligned going into the sync:

Pre-call deliverables (we will share these before Monday):
- Lightweight security summary + SOC2 point-of-contact (see attached redwood_se_intro.vcf for the contact card)
- Small ingestion example (CSV + manifest) and recommended chunking strategy
- sample_prompts.txt with the 25 prompts we'll run during the quality gate

Evaluation milestones (owners):
- Day 0 (Kickoff) — align success criteria and test data; owner: Hannah / Samir
- Day 1–3 (Ingest smoke test) — owner: Atlas DE + Dev Patel (Redwood)
- Day 4–7 (Profiling) — throughput & latency matrix; owner: Dev Patel / Atlas SRE
- Day 8–14 (Quality evaluation) — Neha runs prompt sets, collects metrics (exact-match, BLEU-ish signals, human pass rate)
- Decision review & next steps — Vivek will coordinate commercial artifacts (SOW / pricing)

A couple of constraints to call out up front: if you plan to evaluate very long-context documents (>8k tokens) we should discuss a quantized variant and cost implications; otherwise the default baseline will use the 8k profile. If you can share a representative document sample (5–10 documents) before Monday, I’ll run a local ingest test and report back results within 48 hours.

Attachments: sample_prompts.txt (text, 4KB); redwood_se_intro.vcf (vCard, 1KB)

Looking forward — I’ll post the Drive folder after this message.

—
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Thanks — confirmed for Mon 30 Nov at 10:00 AM PT. Priya (engineering lead) here — attendees from our side will be me, Samir, plus one platform engineer (Liam O'Connor). We’ll add Liam to the calendar invite.

We’ll also upload a 5-document sample set to the Drive link you mentioned by Sunday EOD so you can run the ingest smoke test. Please include recommended manifest format and any pre-processing notes.

See you Monday.

– Priya
Engineering Lead, Atlas Retail
priya.m@atlasretail.com
